independence: Auditor session 3311618b2a8b did not author this draft. Translator: i18n-translator, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5. Auditor: i18n-auditor, deepseek/deepseek-flash (different agent, different model, different session). No translation/MT service was used; findings are reasoned from the English source, the context sidecar, the es style guide/glossary and the shipped es catalogues.

findings.current: {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} por delante} many {{count, number, ::group-off} por delante} other {{count, number, ::group-off} por delante}}
findings.problem: Width, not wording: the datum sits on a shrink-0, never-wrapping line beside the state word and grows by 5-6 cells over English ('100 por delante' 15 vs '100 ahead' 9; '1000000 por delante' 19 vs 13). The sidecar sets no maxCells hint and '2-3 words' is met.
findings.suggestion: No change recommended: 'por delante' is the shortest wording that keeps the meaning ('delante' alone is ambiguous; 'en espera' would misstate it as queue length). Risk recorded so a rendered narrow-card frame can be checked at QA.

findings.current: Generando locución… / Locución generada / Generando # locuciones… / Lote de locuciones
findings.problem: 'locución' is a NEW product term with no row in i18n/glossary.md and no row in the es style guide, and zero shipped precedent (0 hits for 'locución'/'voz en off' across all 159 es catalogues; the shipped generated-speech vocabulary is 'voz': ui.common.errors.speech_generation 'No se pudo generar la voz', ui.common.errors.speech_no_audio). It is native and precise (locutor/locución is the standard broadcast term) and shorter than 'voz en off'.
findings.suggestion: Keep 'locución'. Process follow-up, not a copy change: the wave that first uses it must record it in i18n/style-guides/es.md (or the glossary) so the next es surface reuses one word.

findings.current: Generando vídeo… / Generando locución… / Generando efecto de sonido… / Generando imagen…
findings.problem: Bare singular after the gerund. Shipped es uses both patterns, but for a singular countable object it usually keeps the article (ui.chat.checkpoint.generating_name 'Generando el nombre…', 'Cargando el navegador', 'Cargando el agente guardado…'), while bare forms ship mostly with plurals/mass nouns ('Cargando agentes', 'Cargando mensajes programados…').
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as a deliberate terse register that also keeps the four branches parallel; if the wave prefers fuller sentences, 'Generando el vídeo… / el efecto de sonido…' still fits the 3-word budget. No change requested.

findings.current: vídeo / Vídeo generado / Generando # vídeos… / Lote de vídeos
findings.problem: Cross-namespace spelling drift in SHIPPED copy, not introduced here: the draft's 'vídeo' matches ui.canvas.files.videos 'Vídeos', ui.canvas.file_rows.video 'Vídeo', ui.chat.directory.folder.videos 'Vídeos', ui.canvas.video_preview.* and ui.onboarding.tour.welcome.body.2 'vídeos' (6 values), but ui.library.category.video and ui.library.kind.video ship 'Video' without the accent (2 values).
findings.suggestion: No change to these 14 keys: 'vídeo' is the RAE standard form and the majority shipped spelling. The unaccented ui.library pair is a pre-existing drift whose fix belongs to ui.library, out of this scope.

observations: INFO translator notes, claim 'verbs are gerund lower-case like tool_row.verb.*.running': the shipped tool_row.verb.*.running values are capitalised ('Actualizando proyecto', 'Escribiendo'), so that citation is inaccurate; the conclusion still holds through ui.chat.canonical.tool.never_sent_composed/empty ('nada redactado', 'redactado: {size}'), which are lower-case and are the true siblings.

INFO translator notes, claim 'batch has no shipped es term': accurate for the es chat catalogues, but 'lote' already ships in ui.settings.imports.selection_limit ('por lotes') and ui.settings.configuration.delegated_retention_copy… ('en lotes limitados'), which strengthens the reuse rather than contradicting it.

INFO reuse claims verified against shipped es bytes: 'en cola' (ui.settings.imports.state_queued, ui.settings.imports.phase_queued, ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.queued, ui.chat.ask_queue.status.open 'En cola — el agente continúa', ui.chat.aside.adopt.queued); 'redactado/nada redactado' (ui.chat.canonical.tool.never_sent_*); 'Generando' (ui.chat.checkpoint.generating_name); 'imagen/imágenes' (ui.chat.canonical.image_label, fold.*_images, attachment_refusal.images_*).

INFO error register: 'Falló el lote de …' has shipped precedent for the same construction (ui.chat.canonical.older_history.failed.short 'Falló la carga', ui.chat.run_details.reader.failed 'Falló', ui.common.errors.request_http 'La solicitud falló', ui.common.errors.speech_no_audio 'La generación de voz falló'), and 'solicitud' for request is settled (ui.common.errors.media_request, ui.browser.media_access.prompt_label 'Solicitud de micrófono').

INFO ICU execution: every message formatted with intl-messageformat (worktree node_modules) for counts 0,1,2,3,5,11,21,22,100,1000000 and materials image/video/voiceover/sound_effect plus the raw wire value 'sound-effect' and an unknown value (both fall to the 'other' branch, same as English).
